desc.zh: 掩體、橋梁、隧道與關鍵設施在爆炸荷載下的動態反應、破壞模式與補強設計。
desc.en: Dynamic response, failure modes and retrofit design of shelters, bridges, tunnels and critical facilities under blast loading.

desc.zh: 纖維混凝土、UHPC、聚脲彈性塗層、無機聚合物與 3D 列印材料的靜態與高應變率性能。
desc.en: Static and high-strain-rate behavior of fiber-reinforced concrete, UHPC, polyurea coatings, geopolymers and 3D-printed materials.

tags: High strain rate · impact testing · material qualification

desc.zh: 以 LS-DYNA、ExDAM、BlastFoam 重現極端情境，再用縮尺與現地爆炸試驗驗證模型。
desc.en: Reproducing extreme events with LS-DYNA, ExDAM and BlastFoam, validated by scaled and field explosive tests.

desc.zh: 機場跑道、橋梁與設施的損傷評估、快速搶修工法，以及高早強無機聚合修補材料。
desc.en: Damage assessment and rapid repair of runways, bridges and facilities, including high-early-strength geopolymer repair materials.

tags: Damage assessment · rapid repair · repair materials

desc.zh: 爆炸波、衝擊加速度與高強度噪音造成的腦部、頸椎與聽力損傷評估，以及個人防護技術。
desc.en: Brain, cervical spine and hearing injury from blast waves, impact acceleration and impulse noise, and personal protection.
